citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 11:55am on 21-July-
2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by knocking on the door to the house and the dog kennel building.
Both phone numbers on file were called and APHIS Officials spoke with the son-in-law of the licensee who stated she was
not available today. The licensee made contact with APHIS Officials at 12:25 PM and stated she was out of the area for
appointments and would not be available for an inspection today. Failure to provide access to the facility, animals, and
records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued failure to provide access is serious and may
result in enforcement action.
End Section
